meta.description: One shared, manual reminder sender for Recruitment and Onboarding. It receives source, reminderType, recipientEmail, recipientName, subjectName, requestedByEmail, and optional onboardingLeadEmail/roleTitle. Recruitment reminders CC the requester; onboarding reminders CC the assigned onboarding lead. It never receives or creates a Jotform URL. Set the production webhook URL as N8N_FORM_REMINDER_URL in the app after activating.
